# 3D ANOVA

![3D ANOVA function icon](../../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/statistics/39-anova_3d.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../../index.md)

Three-factor decomposition including all interactions. Signed levels fixed/random. GS mixed-model denominator projection and -1 unavailable tests are explicit, not NI-certified Satterthwaite. GS exact-denominator profile: no random factor outside effect uses MSE; one outside uses the union interaction; two outside report F/p=-1 instead of inventing a denominator.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**3D ANOVA**

Analyse trois facteurs et leurs interactions, avec facteurs fixes ou aléatoires explicitement déclarés.

</details>
